description: Fetch one eBid.net listing by its numeric ListingID (eBid Trading API GetListingSingle): title, description, seller, current price, bid count, quantity, condition, start/end times, and shipping cost calculated to a destination country. Works for live and ended listings on any eBid country site. Get ListingIDs from ebid_search.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

listing_id.description: Numeric eBid ListingID (from ebid_search results or an ebid.net listing URL).

ship_to.description: ISO country code to calculate shipping to (e.g. "us", "uk"). Defaults to the site's country.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

name: ebid_listing
title: Ebid Listing
